items.name: Sonnenhof Fleischtomate
items.icon: vine tomato on a cream label band
items.description: Two stacked coral-red vine tomatoes with green calyx and vine in a kraft cardboard tray with a cream label band showing one tomato; no real brand, plain Fleischtomaten from the German veg aisle; soft 3D toy-render look

items.name: Südfrucht Grüne Paprika
items.description: Two green bell peppers (Paprika), slightly taller than wide, one behind the other, radial-shaded with lobed bottoms, creases and lime stems; no text

items.name: Landlust Aubergine
items.description: Two lavender-purple aubergines in natural proportions, one upright in front and one behind, each with a green star-shaped calyx and curved stem; no text

items.name: Frischewerk Kopfsalat
items.description: Standing lime pillow bag of lettuce (Kopfsalat) with a zigzag top seal, leaf-green bottom seal and a cream label panel with one lettuce head; no text
